# TEZZ CONNECT

TEZZ CONNECT is a free browser-based internet performance toolkit.

## Tools
- [Internet speed test](https://tezzconnect.online/): measure download speed, upload speed, HTTP latency and jitter.
- [Internet Doctor](https://tezzconnect.online/internet-doctor): troubleshoot common connection problems.
- [Network tools](https://tezzconnect.online/tools): inspect network and connection information.
- [Global Network](https://tezzconnect.online/global-network): view available aggregate network benchmarks.
- [About TEZZ CONNECT](https://tezzconnect.online/about): learn about the project.

## Documentation
- [Sitemap](https://tezzconnect.online/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://tezzconnect.online/robots.txt)

## Usage notes
- Speed measurements run in the visitor's browser against TEZZ CONNECT endpoints and are estimates of that browser-to-edge connection.
- Regional benchmark contributions are optional and require explicit consent.
- TEZZ CONNECT does not expose a public MCP or autonomous-agent execution API.
